title: Origin
appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV, in English or Arabic: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: Steadier Sources: A fault that could close the app when many addons answered at once, as on the first press of Sources, is fixed.
Lighter on your TV: Memory is kept within bounds while addons answer, and handed back without stalling the picture.
Plug in a drive, that is all: The USB check stops cleanly when the drive is pulled out, touches only its own files, and OK hides it.
